title: The Forgotten Corner
category: Documentary Short Film · In Festival Circuit
synopsis: In a remote corner of south-west Scotland, women are forced to drive two hours to the nearest hospital for maternity care. The Forgotten Corner is an experimental and political documentary about a failing health service and the women it leaves behind.

credits.value: Clara B. Zimmer and Clara Carbajo
